# Unity
> Develop, deploy, and grow with Unity, the world’s leading 3D game engine for games, XR, and industrial applications.

Unity provides tools and services for creating interactive 2D and 3D content, publishing across major platforms, learning development workflows, and supporting game growth through multiplayer, monetization, analytics, and live operations.

## Core Platform
- [Unity Home](https://unity.com/): Main entry point for Unity’s engine, products, industry solutions, and developer resources.
- [Products](https://unity.com/products): Overview of Unity engine plans, tools, and supporting development services.
- [Games](https://unity.com/games): Solutions and workflows for building, operating, and growing games with Unity.
- [Industry](https://unity.com/industry): Unity applications for automotive, manufacturing, architecture, retail, and other industries.
- [Pricing](https://unity.com/products): Product plans and purchasing options for Unity tools and services.
- [Support Services](https://unity.com/support-services): Technical support offerings, success plans, and enterprise assistance options.

## Documentation
- [Unity Documentation](https://docs.unity3d.com/): Central documentation portal for the Unity Editor, runtime, and platform workflows.
- [Unity Manual](https://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/index.html): Conceptual and task-based documentation for using the Unity Editor and features.
- [Scripting API](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/): API reference for UnityEngine, UnityEditor, and related scripting namespaces.
- [Unity Versions](https://docs.unity3d.com/): Access documentation for current and legacy Unity releases.
- [Package Documentation](https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/): Documentation hub for official Unity packages and package-specific manuals.
- [Unity Hub Manual](https://docs.unity3d.com/hub/manual/index.html): Guidance for installing editors, managing projects, and using Unity Hub.

## Developer Guides
- [Getting Started with Unity](https://learn.unity.com/tutorial/start-learning-unity): Introductory learning path for new Unity creators and developers.
- [Learn Platform](https://learn.unity.com/): Tutorials, pathways, and projects for Unity development skills.
- [Unity Best Practices](https://unity.com/resources): Resource hub containing guides, e-books, and practical development content.
- [Resources](https://unity.com/resources): Collection of technical content, reports, guides, and customer stories.
- [Community](https://unity.com/community): Community programs, forums, events, and ways to connect with other Unity developers.
- [Support Knowledge Base](https://support.unity.com/): Help articles and troubleshooting resources for Unity products and services.

## Multiplayer and Live Services
- [Unity Gaming Services](https://unity.com/solutions/gaming-services): Overview of backend and live game services for multiplayer and operations.
- [Multiplayer](https://unity.com/solutions/multiplayer): Networking and multiplayer solutions for building connected game experiences.
- [Cloud Save](https://unity.com/solutions/gaming-services/player-management): Player data and progression management within Unity Gaming Services.
- [Lobby](https://unity.com/solutions/gaming-services/player-management): Matchmaking-adjacent player grouping and session preparation services.
- [Relay](https://unity.com/solutions/multiplayer): Connectivity support for peer-hosted multiplayer sessions across platforms.
- [Vivox Voice and Text Chat](https://unity.com/products/vivox-voice-chat): In-game voice and text communication services for multiplayer experiences.

## Growth and Monetization
- [Grow Solutions](https://unity.com/solutions/grow): Tools for user acquisition, monetization, analytics, and player engagement.
- [Unity Ads](https://unity.com/products/unity-ads): Advertising solution for acquiring users and monetizing mobile games.
- [LevelPlay](https://unity.com/products/levelplay): Mediation and monetization platform for optimizing ad revenue across networks.
- [Analytics](https://unity.com/solutions/grow): Insights and performance tools for understanding player behavior and business metrics.
- [User Acquisition](https://unity.com/solutions/grow/user-acquisition): Campaign tools and services for scaling game installs and audience growth.
- [Monetization](https://unity.com/solutions/grow/monetization): Revenue optimization tools for ads, mediation, and in-app growth strategies.

## Asset and Content Creation
- [Asset Store](https://assetstore.unity.com/): Marketplace for art, tools, templates, and plugins for Unity projects.
- [Asset Store Publisher Portal](https://publisher.assetstore.unity3d.com/): Portal for publishers managing packages, sales, and asset submissions.
- [Muse](https://unity.com/products/muse): AI-assisted tools for generating and iterating on game and application content.
- [Cloud Content Delivery](https://unity.com/solutions/gaming-services/content-management): Remote content distribution for live games and application updates.
- [Version Control](https://unity.com/solutions/version-control): Source control solution tailored for large Unity and real-time 3D projects.
- [DevOps](https://unity.com/solutions/devops): Build automation and team workflow tools for continuous integration and delivery.

## Industry Solutions
- [Industry Overview](https://unity.com/industry): Overview of Unity solutions for enterprise and industrial real-time 3D use cases.
- [Automotive](https://unity.com/industry/automotive-transportation-manufacturing): Real-time 3D workflows for vehicle design, HMI, simulation, and visualization.
- [Manufacturing](https://unity.com/industry/automotive-transportation-manufacturing): Digital twin, simulation, and training solutions for manufacturing environments.
- [Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations](https://unity.com/industry/aec): Visualization and immersive review workflows for built environment projects.
- [Retail and Consumer Products](https://unity.com/industry/retail): Interactive product visualization and customer experience applications.
- [Government and Aerospace](https://unity.com/industry/government-aerospace): Simulation, training, and mission-focused real-time 3D applications.

## Community and Support
- [Unity Community](https://unity.com/community): Community hub for forums, user groups, events, and creator programs.
- [Discussions](https://discussions.unity.com/): Community discussion forums for Unity development questions and collaboration.
- [Issue Tracker](https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/): Public tracker for known Unity bugs, regressions, and issue status.
- [Support Services](https://unity.com/support-services): Enterprise and technical support plans for Unity customers.
- [Support Portal](https://support.unity.com/): Customer support articles, account help, and troubleshooting documentation.
- [Status Page](https://status.unity.com/): Service availability and incident reporting for Unity online systems.

## News and Updates
- [Unity Blog](https://blog.unity.com/): Product announcements, technical articles, case studies, and company updates.
- [Release Notes](https://unity.com/releases/editor/whats-new): Highlights and changes in recent Unity Editor releases.
- [Unity 6](https://unity.com/releases/unity-6): Overview of Unity 6 features, release information, and adoption guidance.
- [Case Studies](https://unity.com/case-study): Customer stories showing how teams use Unity across games and industries.
- [Events and Webinars](https://unity.com/events): Upcoming Unity events, webinars, and conference sessions.
- [Reports and E-books](https://unity.com/resources): Downloadable research, guides, and strategic content for developers and businesses.
